 NFC Playoff Picture: Packers stay in Wild Card spot with win
 The Green Bay Packers stick in seventh place with their Week 8 win.
 by Matt Warren Oct 30, 2026, 3:39 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 If the Green Bay Packers had lost to fall to .500 on the season, they also would have fallen out of their playoff spot. With their home win on Thursday, they ensured they would stick in a playoff spot well into November.
 After moving to 5-3 overall and 4-3 in the NFC, the Packers can’t be passed by the Seattle Seahawks for that seventh slot. The Seahawks have a worse NFC record in the first tiebreaker even with a win on Sunday.
 The Packers won’t be able to pass the Detroit Lions into sixth place this week because of Detroit’s Week 7 win over Green Bay. So the Packers will stay seventh.
 Here are the NFC standings after Thursday night:
 NFC playoff standings with the Packers win
 1. Minnesota Vikings (6-0)
 2. San Francisco 49ers (6-1)
 3. New York Giants (4-2-1)
 4. Carolina Panthers (3-4, win over ATL)
 5. Chicago Bears (5-2)
 6. Detroit Lions (4-2)
 7. Green Bay Packers (5-3) 
 8. Seattle Seahawks (4-3)
 9. Atlanta Falcons (3-4, loss to CAR, 3-2 NFC)
 10. Los Angeles Rams (3-4, 2-2 NFC)
 11. Dallas Cowboys (3-4, 2-3 NFC)
 12. Tampa Bay Buccaneers (2-5, 1-0 NFCS)
 13. New Orleans Saints (2-5, 0-1 NFCS, 1-3 NFC)
 14. Arizona Cardinals (2-5, 1-4 NFC, 3 Strength of Victory)
 15. Philadelphia Eagles (2-5, 1-4 NFC, 2.5 Strength of Victory)
 16. Washington Commanders (1-4-1)
